scope: 17 unique India frontend internship and entry-level frontend/web development postings from 17 employer publishers, collected on 2026-10-09 (Asia/Calcutta). Purposeful web-search sample of readable public employer career pages and employer-hosted applicant-tracking pages; not a random or nationwide representative sample. Includes internships and roles explicitly labelled junior, fresher, trainee or 0–2 years. Counts use only short, role-specific requirements/stack excerpts below, including preferred skills and relevant duties, with omissions marked by ellipses. No skills are inferred. This is a dated snapshot, not live vacancy data; availability was not confirmed with recruiters. Target: 15–20 postings; collected: 17.
method: Opened and read each original posting using web browsing on 2026-10-09; search snippets alone were not accepted. Retained concise excerpts, checked India location and entry-level eligibility, and compared publisher, role, location, source URL and available posting IDs for duplicates. Only one role per publisher is included. Employer IDs are retained when visible; other stable IDs are explicitly collector-assigned URL/role keys. No login, application submission or restriction bypass was used.
